items.text:
I haven't gotten a chance to play much of Ostranauts outside of the early access period, so a lot of stuff might be different now. The basic gameplay loop is quite simple. You get in your ship, fly it out to the space scrapyard and rip copper wire and gas cylinders and the occasional fusion reactor out of derelect ships and sell them. Sometimes you have to deal with threats, included but not limited to pirates, the police, other scrappers, eldritch horrors, and your own incompetence. You then buy more equipment, improve your ship, hire people to do more work, and so on. Every ship system is very detailed, and one careless mistake can end a run if you're not careful. Crash into a ship and get a hull breach without a patch kit? Run out of fuel? Drain your batteries and lose communication with anyone who might be able to help you? You really have to think ahead if you want to succeed, even if it's only a few basic steps.

Dialogue and recruitment is kind of weird, but there have been some major improvements to how it was in the past. Same with combat, which uses the same system as dialogue, similar to their previous games.

The game can be kind of repetitive, especially in the early game where you're just scrapping ships, but as you get some cash you'll be able to be a more active participant in some more interesting aspects of the game and improve your tools to scrap much more effectively. I haven't done much ship construction but that's an option, and of course you can modify your ship in limitless ways to make it your own. The nature of NPCs feels a bit random and often a bit too quirky for my taste (case in point, the randomly generated weed smoking apparently bisexual Muslim who I seduced to gain access to the black market on base), but I'm sure some will appreciate it, such as those who really like Rimworld. Overall, I'd recommend it on sale.
items.text_zh:
除了抢先体验期之外，我还没怎么玩过Ostranauts，所以现在很多东西可能都不一样了。基本的游戏循环相当简单。你进入你的飞船，飞到太空废料场，从废弃飞船上拆下铜线、气瓶，偶尔还有聚变反应堆，然后把它们卖掉。有时你必须应对威胁，包括但不限于海盗、警察、其他拾荒者、诡异恐怖之物，以及你自己的无能。然后你购买更多设备，改进你的飞船，雇人做更多工作，等等。每个飞船系统都非常详细，如果你不小心，一个粗心的错误就可能结束一次游戏。撞上一艘飞船，船体破裂却没有修补工具包？燃料耗尽？耗尽电池，失去与任何可能帮助你的人的联系？如果你想成功，你真的必须提前思考，即使只是几个基本步骤。

对话和招募有点奇怪，但相比过去已经有了重大改进。战斗也是如此，它使用与对话相同的系统，类似于他们之前的游戏。

游戏可能会有点重复，尤其是在早期，你只是在拆解飞船，但当你获得一些现金后，你就能更积极地参与游戏中一些更有趣的方面，并改进你的工具，更有效地拆解。我没怎么做飞船建造，但那是一个选项，当然你可以以无限的方式修改你的飞船，让它成为你自己的。NPC的本质感觉有点随机，而且对我来说常常有点太古怪了（比如，那个随机生成的、抽大麻的、显然是双性恋的穆斯林，我勾引他以获得基地黑市的进入权），但我相信有些人会喜欢，比如那些真正喜欢《环世界》的人。总的来说，我推荐在打折时购买。

observations.evidence: The nature of NPCs feels a bit random and often a bit too quirky for my taste
